context: The skill should write priority fallback code with Optional as the selection boundary, not presence-check/value-read control flow.

checklist.name: Creates requested resolver
checklist.description: Creates WorkspaceResolver.java with resolve(Optional<String>, Optional<String>, String).

checklist.name: Uses direct priority boundary
checklist.description: Uses cliWorkspace.or(() -> environmentWorkspace).orElse(defaultWorkspace), map/orElseGet, or an equivalent direct Optional priority boundary.

checklist.name: No presence-check value read
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() for ordinary fallback.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), lists, or loops to unwrap either Optional.

checklist.name: Preserves priority behavior
checklist.description: Returns CLI before environment before default, without evaluating a later value as the winner when an earlier one is present.
